physical_interface_mappings.description: Comma-separated list of mappings of physical network names to physical interface names (e.g., physnet1:eth1,physnet2:eth2).

vni_ranges.description: Comma-separated list of VXLAN network identifier (VNI) ranges for tenant networks (e.g., 1:1000).

enable_vxlan.description: Enable or disable VXLAN overlay networks.

arp_responder.description: Enable or disable ARP responder for VXLAN to reply to ARP requests locally.

vxlan_local_ip.description: Local IP address for VXLAN UDP endpoint. Must be reachable between compute hosts.

tenant_network_types.description: Ordered list of network types supported for tenant networks.

bridge_mappings.description: Comma-separated list of mappings of physical network names to Linux bridge names (e.g., physnet1:br-eth1).

enable_security_group.description: Enable or disable security groups for instances.

enable_dhcp_options.description: Enable or disable DHCP options for security group rules.

min_agent_rounds.description: Minimum number of agent cycles to wait before reporting state to server.

polling_interval.description: Seconds between agent state reports to the server (lower = more frequent).

registration_delay.description: Seconds to wait before re-registering with the server after failure.
